understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece on a goal tile marked + at the same time; the level is won only when all goals are occupied.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: A piece is selected and moved by clicking a reachable position. Walls and obstacles block movement, and clicks into blocked or unreachable positions have no effect. Movement may involve pushing when another movable object is in the way, while pieces cannot pass through obstacles. Only selectable pieces can be repositioned.
